note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_howto.py; type=manual require agent/render or domain-expert inspection.

GATE_1_pre_creation_foundation.text: Trademark Clearance Report complete; verdict CLEAR or operator-approved CAUTION; all subtitle candidates screened
Skill Domain code assigned from the ten-domain table
Audience, declared skill level, and prerequisite floor documented
Outcome promise identified and is specific + achievable
Quick-Win Deliverable identified and achievable by end of Chapter 3 (or 20% of chapters, whichever comes first)
Chapter count maps to a book size and its competitor-informed page band
Auto-configuration announced (pathway, page band, visual density, font, spacing, Design Signature)
Expert panel confirmed for the domain (Construction Authority for HOWTO-TRADE, etc.)
Applicable safety standards (OSHA/CPSC/ANSI/NEC/EPA) identified for the domain
Licensed-trade disclaimer requirement confirmed and drafted if required

GATE_2_per_chapter_content.text: Chapter Learning Objective stated at chapter open (one measurable sentence)
Every procedure has a Pre-Step Materials block listing all tools and quantities before Step 1
Every step contains exactly one action verb and one instruction
Decision Point Boxes present at every procedural fork
Failure-Recovery Boxes present after every complete procedure
Safety Callout Boxes present at every hazard step, not only in the Introduction
Step image or STEP IMAGE PROMPT block present for every step
No undefined technical terms introduced without definition
Both metric and imperial measurements present for every measurement
Anti-AI language protocol enforced; no prohibited phrases
Chapter ends with a Chapter Checkpoint (3-5 bullets)

GATE_3_instructional_design_audit.text: Instructional Design Authority confirms every procedure executable at the declared skill level
Mental execution trace complete: first-time reader can follow every step without external knowledge
Quick-Win Chapter delivers a tangible, demonstrable reader result
All Decision Point Boxes cover all realistic conditions; no uncovered fork
Failure-Recovery Boxes derived from real practitioner failure patterns, confirmed by domain expert
Safety callouts validated against applicable OSHA/CPSC/ANSI/NEC/EPA standard; none missing or incorrect
Licensed-trade disclaimer present in chapter if required
Chapter word count and page estimate keep the book within page-band targets

GATE_4_final_certification.text: Zone 1 (Foundation & Quick Win): outcome promise introduced, prerequisites stated, Quick Win delivered by Chapter 3
Zone 2 (Core Skill Expansion): chapters sequence without prerequisite gaps
Zone 3 (Mastery & Continuation): advanced techniques, troubleshooting synthesis, next-steps guidance present
Front matter complete and in order: Title -> Copyright -> TOC -> Preface -> How to Use -> Introduction
Preface exactly 1 page; How to Use exactly 1 page; Conclusion exactly 1.5 pages
Licensed-trade disclaimer on Copyright Page if required
Visible page numbers start at Introduction (page 1); front matter unnumbered
Design Signature consistent across all chapters and not repeating the last five register entries
Author name consistent across Title Page, Copyright Page, all metadata
No prohibited AI-pattern language in any chapter
Safety accuracy 100%: all callouts validated against applicable professional standards
All technical terms defined in body text at first use and in the Glossary appendix
